title: Resource selection algorithm reads the loading attribute before the parser has appended it
body:
The [resource selection algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#concept-media-load-algorithm) reads the [lazy loading attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#lazy-loading-attribute) in its third step, before it awaits a stable state:

> If the [media element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#media-element)'s [lazy loading attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#lazy-loading-attribute) is in the [Eager](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#attr-loading-eager-state) state or [scripting is disabled](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-n-noscript), set the [media element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#media-element)'s [delaying-the-load-event flag](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to true (this [delays the load event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-lifecycle.html#delay-the-load-event)).

That step is reached synchronously from the `src` attribute change steps: 

> If a `src` attribute of a [media element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#media-element) is set or changed, the user agent must invoke the [media element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#media-element)'s [media element load algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#media-element-load-algorithm)

...and the media element load algorithm reaches "Invoke the [media element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#media-element)'s [resource selection algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#concept-media-load-algorithm)" with no early return.

The parser appends a token's attributes one at a time: 

> [Append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-append) each attribute in the given token to *element*

...in [create an element for a token](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#create-an-element-for-the-token). So for `<video src=x loading=lazy>`, appending `src` invokes the resource selection algorithm while `loading` is still absent, and the [missing value default](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#lazy-loading-attribute) is Eager:

* `<video loading=lazy src=x>` → Lazy → [delaying-the-load-event flag](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#delaying-the-load-event-flag) not set
* `<video src=x loading=lazy>` → Eager → [delaying-the-load-event flag](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#delaying-the-load-event-flag) set to true

The [resource fetch algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#concept-media-load-resource) then parks on the lazy branch:

> If the [will lazy load element steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#will-lazy-load-element-steps) given the [media element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#media-element) return true: … Return.

...without clearing the flag, and nothing else on that path clears it. So in the second order the document's `load` event is delayed until the element's [lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#lazy-load-resumption-steps) are invoked, i.e. until the element intersects the viewport, which may be never.

I think moving the step to after "await a stable state" would fix this.

(Found while reviewing #12473.)
